issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'miễn là' (as long as/provided that) incorrectly renders the Greek 'εἰ μη' (if not). The Greek structure 'εἰ μη τι αδοκιμοι εστε' means 'if you are not [at all] tested/approved', whereas the Vietnamese implies a conditional state of being 'not rejected'.
The Greek 'τι' (at all / anything) in 'εἰ μη τι αδοκιμοι εστε' is omitted, which slightly softens the rhetorical emphasis of the original.
